name: Modern development environment for Win98 (PHP Git client)

mentions.name: Modern development environment for Win98 (PHP Git client)
mentions.description: A retro development environment for Windows 98 in which a server exposes Git as HTTP endpoints and a Git client written in PHP runs under MS-DOS, sidestepping the need to backport Git in C or use Cygwin. Vim 7.3 and GNU coreutils already run in MS-DOS, and a one-click installer is planned to bundle XAMPP, Vim, and all the created tooling.
mentions.problem: Git cannot run natively on Win98/MS-DOS; backporting Git would require learning C, which the author has no patience for, and Cygwin is not wanted.
mentions.source_excerpt: Creating a modern development environment for win98. Currently I’m working on a git client. I have no patience for learning C. So backporting git is not an option. I also don’t want to use cygwin. So I’m using a server to expose git as http endpoints and coding a git client in php to use in msdos. I have Vim 7.3 and and gnu coreutils working in msdos already. So soon I will have a very nice dev environment. I want to create a one click installer which gives you xampp, vim and then all the tooling I’ve created.
